department: School of Mathematical and Statistical Sciences

deadline.value: For fall admission (mid-August start), submit by January 15; spring applicants by October 1.
deadline.quote: If you are applying for admission in the fall term (which begins in mid-August), it is recommended that you submit your application materials by Jan. 15.

app_fee.value: The School charges no application fee for Summer 2023 and later.
app_fee.quote: The application fee will no longer be charged for anyone applying to Summer 2023 and beyond.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee is charged, so no waiver is needed.
fee_waiver.quote: The application fee will no longer be charged for anyone applying to Summer 2023 and beyond.

gre_general.value: The GRE General is recommended but not required.
gre_general.quote: recommends that all students submit GRE general test scores

also.quote: Note: The GRE general test scores are not required.

gre_subject.value: The page does not mention a Mathematics GRE Subject test.

toefl_min.value: The School requires TOEFL scores but gives no minimum on these pages.
toefl_min.quote: The School of Mathematical and Statistical Sciences requires international students to submit TOEFL scores

ielts_min.value: No IELTS minimum is given on these pages.

supervisor.value: Admission turns on background and ability, and the research advisor is chosen after admission.
supervisor.quote: The most important criterion for admission is whether a student's background and ability are sufficient to indicate successful completion of the degree program.

funding.value: Financial aid is more competitive than admission to the School.
funding.quote: Selection for financial aid is more competitive than just admission to the school.

entry_route.value: Students may enter with a master's, whose courses can count, or go straight in after prerequisite coursework.
entry_route.quote: Transfer courses and courses completed as a master's student en route to the Ph.D. may be counted toward this requirement.

also.quote: To be accepted into either the M.S. or Ph.D. program, students should have completed prerequisite coursework

notes: School-wide page for math and statistics. The Ph.D. has no separate deadline on its page, so the School's January 15 fall date is used. The October 1 spring date is not a Fall 2027 deadline.
